name: MedHallu
intro: MedHallu是首个专门用于检测大型语言模型医疗幻觉的综合基准，包含10000个高质量问答对，评估模型在医疗领域生成看似合理但事实不准确输出的倾向。
eval_feature_en: The first benchmark focusing on medical hallucination detection, 10K high-quality QA pairs
intro_en: MedHallu is the first comprehensive benchmark specifically designed to detect medical hallucinations in large language models. It contains 10,000 high-quality QA pairs to evaluate models' tendencies to generate plausible but factually incorrect outputs in the medical domain.
mermaid_flowchart:
flowchart LR
    A(Medical Knowledge Base) --> B[Expert Curation]
    B --> C[Medical Fact Extraction]
    C --> D[Question/Statement Generation]
    D --> E{{LLM Response Generation}}
    E --> F{Hallucination Detection}
    F -->|Identified Hallucination| G[Expert Review & Annotation]
    F -->|No Hallucination| H[Factual Statement Validation]
    G --> I(Annotated Hallucination Examples)
    H --> J(Validated Factual Statements)
    I --> K(MedHallu Dataset)
    J --> K
    K --> L[LLM Hallucination Evaluation]
    L --> M[Factual Accuracy Metrics]
    L --> N[Hallucination Rate Metrics]
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Extract 10,000 medical question-answer pairs from PubMedQA dataset"] --> B["Generate diverse hallucinated answers using LLM with temperature variation and hallucination category definitions"]
    B["Generate diverse hallucinated answers using LLM with temperature variation and hallucination category definitions"] --> C["Apply LLM-based quality filtering to candidate hallucinated responses"]
    C["Apply LLM-based quality filtering to candidate hallucinated responses"] --> D["Verify correctness using bidirectional entailment and LLM prompting"]
    D["Verify correctness using bidirectional entailment and LLM prompting"] --> E["Apply TextGrad for sequential improvement of hallucinated samples"]
    E["Apply TextGrad for sequential improvement of hallucinated samples"] --> F["Select best sample by semantic similarity if no high-quality candidate identified"]
    F["Select best sample by semantic similarity if no high-quality candidate identified"] --> G["Stratify samples into easy, medium, and hard detection tiers by hallucination subtlety"]
    G["Stratify samples into easy, medium, and hard detection tiers by hallucination subtlety"] --> H["Evaluate LLMs on binary hallucination detection using F1 score and precision metrics"]
